module.summary: RTT-Inside drift-bounded structural report for ERCOT Abilene / Milam County cluster — one of the largest AI-focused hyperscale superclusters in the world, anchored by OpenAI Stargate and Oracle.

ai.module.description: Cluster-level module manifest for ERCOT Abilene / Milam County. Covers 11 facilities including OpenAI Stargate, Oracle Stargate-adjacent nodes, regional hyperscale developers, and energy-adjacent compute sites.

cluster_mapping.cluster.name: Abilene / Milam County
cluster_mapping.cluster.notes: One of the largest AI-focused builds in the world; extreme energy adjacency; anchored by OpenAI Stargate; rapid land and transmission expansion.

rtt.envelopes.drift.description: Hyperscale AI supercluster growth; extreme land and transmission demand; ongoing site expansion.
rtt.envelopes.coherence.description: Strong alignment between energy adjacency, hyperscale operators, and grid infrastructure.
